_about: 3-31, re-routed by step 128 (the merge): step 127's route shot its first two fireballs from the
right platform's left edge, and since step 114 (G5) a fireball dies on the first solid it touches,
so both died on that platform's corner (8 ticks out) and the shock agent and the crate stood. This
route shoots them from where the line is clear. A portal on the gutter block at (384, 118) and one
on the player: fire_diamond_ent_2199 is taken (64). Right off the block, landing right of the drain
(the gutter's 10-unit slot at x 379-389 would take the diamond): from the right platform at (431,
234) a fireball left burns knight B, whose key drops on the left platform (462). Right onto
lift_ent_2438 and down with it (the port runs it on its own: G2; the original's is sent by a tap),
left onto single_block_plat_low_emissive_ent_2442; from (429.5, 362.3) a fireball at the shock agent
destroys it and its ring (569), and one aimed at (224, 421) clears the block's corner by 1.4 units
and burns crate_2355 at its top corner (606), baring anti_portal_agent_ent_2430. Back onto the lift
at the bottom, up, left off it and under the gutter: the diamond is drained (694). A portal by the
key and one on the player: the key is taken (737). Right to the ledge's end, a portal over the
single block at (392, 340) and one on the player; from the block a shot at (224, 456) kills the bare
agent and its ring (887, R17). A portal by the keyhole at (195, 450) and one on the player: the key
opens it (963) and the yellow door goes (1011); left into the door. Won on tick 1046. Every portal
before the agent dies is 199 px or more from antiportal_2436's centre (160 at 32 x scale, R1). Leans
on G1 (the knight never sees or shoots), G2, G10 and G4.
